design_notes.subject: Upward-trending sparkline (8 data points) on a baseline with vertical tick guides and a coral area-fill beneath; latest data point rendered as a focal cursor dot in coral splash with an outer ring

data_mapping.note: evocative trend shape, not a literal data-viz — no axis labels per brief

colorway.focal_cursor: oklch(0.68 0.165 28), filled + outer ring at 45% opacity
colorway.bronze_theme_dot: oklch(0.80 0.135 75), upper-right margin, distinct from coral cursor

composition: Follows the family 'trends piece -> sparkline silhouette' motif locked in plan/bearings.md
Low-opacity coral wash band behind the chart field
Coral area-fill sweep beneath the rising line
Open-circle markers at interior points, filled coral focal cursor at the latest point
Right-side annotation lead-in tick at cursor y-level
Bronze theme dot at upper-right margin as the family ornamental anchor
